title: Associate Software Engineer
bullets: Own the platform's core REST API (Laravel 12 / PHP 8.2 / PostgreSQL), delivering 150+ endpoints across fleet operations, IoT telemetry, payments, geofencing, and hardware control through a scalable service-oriented architecture.

Built a real-time geofencing system for EVs that automatically shuts down a vehicle when it leaves its permitted zone and re-enables it on return using GPS tracking and Tile38, with an automatic fallback that keeps enforcement working during network outages.

Engineered an ACID-safe order and payment platform with atomic multi-record transactions, rollback guarantees, and priority-based payment resolution across wallet and swap-credit balances, eliminating partial-write and double-charge scenarios.

Designed and secured three authentication flows on a unified API surface (Azure AD SSO, driver PIN authentication, and scoped IoT API keys), complemented by custom RBAC middleware and comprehensive audit logging.

Delivered the operator-facing platform end-to-end, including a Next.js 15 admin dashboard with a custom geofence editor, telemetry analytics, permission-aware UI rendering, and an installable field-officer PWA.

Automated operational reporting through a Python-based data pipeline (pandas, openpyxl, Microsoft Graph API) and integrated bKash payments with idempotent, race-condition-safe reconciliation workflows.

Managed deployment and server operations across three VPS environments (two production, one staging), including Nginx configuration, environment setup, SSL certificates, Git-based releases, PostgreSQL provisioning, backups, queue workers, cron jobs, and production incident handling.
